_about: Hand-labelled interview lines for measuring the G6 trigger rule (reasoning.looks_like_question). 30 questions, 30 statements, Polish and English, written to look like what Whisper actually emits for this interview: mostly Polish with English technical fragments. The negatives deliberately include the hard Polish idioms that OPEN a sentence with an interrogative word without asking anything ('Jak Pan widzi...' = 'as you can see', 'Co ciekawe...' = 'interestingly', 'Powiedzmy, ze...' = "let's say") and candidate-side lines, because the live transcript is MIXED MONO and carries no speaker attribution. Scoring 1.00 here would mean the fixtures were written to flatter the rule.
_measured: See config/settings.py (FIRE_ON_QUESTIONS_ONLY) and agent/session.md for the numbers this set produced.
